name: io.github.RapierCraft/perplexity-comet-mcp
description: Bridge Claude Code with Perplexity Comet for autonomous browsing and tab management

environmentVariables.description: Custom path to Comet browser executable (optional)
environmentVariables.name: COMET_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Loopback CDP host. Only 127.0.0.1/localhost are accepted; defaults to 127.0.0.1.
environmentVariables.name: COMET_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Dedicated agent Comet profile directory. Must be absolute and must not be a personal/default browser profile.
environmentVariables.name: COMET_USER_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Dedicated staging directory for comet_upload. Uploaded files must be absolute paths under this directory.
environmentVariables.name: COMET_UPLOAD_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in managed restart. Defaults off; when enabled, only the MCP-managed child process may be stopped.
environmentVariables.name: COMET_ALLOW_RESTART
